description:
Title: Chainsaw

You produce custom chainsaws on demand.
Your chainsaws have at least 5 properties such as length of the "guide bar" (Schwertlaenge), chain width, electric or motor chainsaw.
After your customer told you the properties, you can start ordering the parts from various online sources (in parallel).
After the parts arrive you have to do a manual inspection of all parts, and then assemble the parts.
During production, you regularly send updates to your customer.
After producing the first saw you send it to your customer.
If he likes it, the rest of his order are produced.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

                  id="Definitions_Chainsaw"

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Properties" name="Chainsaw properties"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Update" name="Production update"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Feedback" name="Feedback on first chainsaw" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_Feedback" messageRef="Msg_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Producer" name="Chainsaw Production" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderParts" name="Order parts from various online sources"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Assemble" name="Assemble chainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_FirstSaw" name="Send first chainsaw to customer"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RestCompleted" name="Rest of order produced"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Update" name="Send production update to customer">
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics id="Loop_Update" testBefore="false"/>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_UpdatesEnded" name="Production updates ended"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Properties" targetRef="Gateway_Production_Split"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_PartsArrived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_PartsArrived" targetRef="ManualTask_Inspect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="ManualTask_Inspect" targetRef="Task_Assemble"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_Assemble" targetRef="SendTask_FirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="SendTask_FirstSaw" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_Feedback"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" name="Customer likes first chainsaw" sourceRef="Gateway_Accepted" targetRef="Task_ProduceRest">

    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" name="Customer does not like first chainsaw" sourceRef="Gateway_Accepted" targetRef="End_Rejected">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!customerLikesFirstChainsaw}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_ProduceRest" targetRef="End_RestCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="SendTask_Update" targetRef="End_UpdatesEnded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
